summary.text: Joan Huffman, a Republican attorney from Houston, represents Texas Senate District 17 and has served in the Senate since 2008. She chairs the Senate Committee on Finance.

paragraphs.text: Huffman began her public service career in 1981 as a secretary in the Harris County District Attorney's office, and earned her undergraduate degree from Louisiana State University and a law degree from South Texas College of Law through night classes.
She became a prosecutor, advancing to Chief Felony Prosecutor, and later served as a twice-elected judge of the 183rd Criminal District Court in Harris County.
She was first elected to the Texas Senate in 2008 and has been re-elected five times.
Her district comprises Colorado, Jackson, Matagorda and Wharton counties and portions of Brazoria, Fort Bend, Harris and Waller counties.
